title: As a founder, I can connect my accounting platform (QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite) and actuals land in the model without manual exports
As a finance lead, payroll/HRIS and CRM connectors bring headcount and pipeline data into the same model as the books
As a finance lead, each connected source shows when it last synced, and data refreshes on a documented schedule after the close
As a finance lead, I can load a CSV or spreadsheet as a first-class data source when no connector exists
As a finance lead, I can build a driver-based model with growth, price-point, and hiring assumptions rather than hard-coded rows
As a finance lead, the forecast re-baselines on fresh actuals after each close without rebuilding the model
As a finance lead, the model produces P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow views with drill-down from any figure to its source records
As a finance lead, any number in a report traces back through the formulas and source lines that produced it
As a founder, I can create scenarios (a hiring wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case) and compare them side by side
As a founder, burn and cash runway are computed per scenario, so I can see how a decision moves the zero-cash date
As a finance lead, each scenario records its assumptions and who changed them, so a comparison is auditable
As a finance lead, budget-vs-actuals runs by department and account, with drill-down into the transactions behind a variance
As a finance lead, the platform explains a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance rather than only flagging it
As a finance lead, I can plan headcount at the role level, tied to payroll actuals, with planned hires flowing into the expense forecast
As a finance lead, I can build a revenue plan from CRM pipeline or subscription data and track it against actuals
As a founder, I can generate a board pack (metrics, variance commentary, forecast) from the live model instead of assembling slides by hand
As a founder, I can share dashboards and reports with the board or team under scoped access
As a finance lead, I can export reports to slides, PDF, or spreadsheet formats
As a finance lead, a bi-directional Excel or Google Sheets add-in pulls live data into my spreadsheets and pushes edits back
As a finance lead, department-scoped permissions let a budget owner see and edit their numbers without exposing the whole company
As a finance lead, every change to the model is logged with who changed what and when, and can be rolled back

As an AI-native user, an agent can ask the model a finance question (runway, forecast, variance) and the figures come from the platform's calculation engine with lineage, not from a language model's guess
As an AI-native user, an agent can build or update a forecast or scenario through a documented machine interface, and the change lands in the same audit trail as a human edit
As a finance lead, the platform notifies me when a metric moves against plan or a reporting deadline approaches, before I ask
As a developer, I can pull model outputs (metrics, forecasts, scenario results) into a warehouse or internal tool through a documented export or API
